slug: 2025-05-20 LeSwitch expands to localized POS transactions (Central Bank of Lesotho)

LSO.note: Document does not mention public procurement.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Lesotho, with leading banks, introduced localized POS transactions under the LeSwitch national switch from 11 May 2025, after ATM localization in October 2024, with all local card transactions handled in-country by early 2025.

LSO.note: Document states no consumer-protection rule or redress body.
Only Visa and Mastercard for international payments, no named digital corridor.
Document does not mention government payments to people.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: LeSwitch introduced instant payments between banks and mobile money (M-Pesa and Khetsi) in 2021, per Standard Lesotho Bank's Samuel Koetle.
LeSwitch, formerly the National Payment Switch, connects banks and mobile money wallets and now carries local ATM and POS debit card transactions, with POS in pilot from 11 May 2025.
Mobile money services M-Pesa and Khetsi are named as connected to LeSwitch for instant payments with banks.

LSO.note: Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
